commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Darren England has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+5' 0 - 5 A superb goal from great team play! Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the left post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
90+1' Darren England blows his whistle. Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) commits a foul after dangerous play.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' Sunderland enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
88' Substitution. Chris Wood leaves the pitch and is replaced by Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham).
87' The corner is swung in but Sunderland can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
87' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Matz Sels makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the left side of the goal.

86' A neat pass is well received by Wilson Isidor (Sunderland), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
83' Luca Netz (Nottingham) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Darren England stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
79' Sunderland take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
77' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 57:43.
77' Omar Alderete (Sunderland) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles over the bar.
76' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Darren England had an easy-decision to make.
75' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
72' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
69' Darren England shows a yellow card to Neco Williams (Nottingham) for his blatant foul.
67' Substitution. Igor Jesus makes his way off the pitch and Ryan Yates (Nottingham) comes on as his replacement.
67' Vitor Pereira has decided to make a change. Luca Netz (Nottingham) replaces Omari Hutchinson.
65' The manager makes a subsitution with Wilson Isidor (Sunderland) coming on for Habib Diarra.
65' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Sunderland due to a foul in the build-up play.
62' The Sunderland players halt their celebrations as referee Darren England makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
61' After a few ricochets the ball falls to Daniel Ballard (Sunderland) who fires home from inside the box. The effort goes into the top right corner and the score changes to 1:4.
60' Igor Jesus (Nottingham) has tested the patience of referee Darren England and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
60' It looks like Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) saw red with that tackle. Darren England won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
58' Yellow card. Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.

58' Omar Alderete (Sunderland) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Matz Sels was alert and the score remained the same.
57' An attempted cross from Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) is cleared.
56' Chris Wood (Nottingham) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
55' Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
54' Igor Jesus (Nottingham) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Darren England no option but to blow his whistle.
51' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Habib Diarra (Sunderland) duly receives a yellow card.
51' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) was quite harsh and Darren England didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
50' Here comes a substitution. Morato (Nottingham) is brought on as a substitute for Cunha.
50' Neco Williams (Nottingham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
49' Cunha (Nottingham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
47' Darren England blows for a foul after Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
47' Sunderland seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Regis Le Bris probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Christopher Rigg. He is replaced by Reinildo Mandava (Sunderland).
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) comes off for Nicolas Dominguez.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.

45' Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Darren England with no other option than to blow for a foul.
43' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
41' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
40' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Granit Xhaka (Sunderland). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
39' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

37' Ola Aina (Nottingham) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
36' Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Darren England blows his whistle for a foul.
34' 0 - 3 Goal! Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) shows perfect technique and produces a first-time effort from just outside the box that goes into the bottom left corner. It's 0:3.
34' The ball is out of play. Nottingham will have a chance to score from a corner.
31' 0 - 2 Chris Wood (Nottingham) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and fires into the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
30' The resulting set piece from Nottingham is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
30' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
29' Nottingham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
29' A cross into the box from Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) is cleared.
28' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
28' The Nottingham players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
26' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall.
25' Darren England blows his whistle after Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.

22' That was a nice football moment. Chris Wood (Nottingham) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the right post. Robin Roefs guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
17' 0 - 1 Trai Hume (Sunderland) attempts to head the ball away from inside the six-yard box, but unluckily he turns a cross from the resulting corner into the roof of his own net.
17' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
16' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball goes behind for a corner. Nottingham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
16' Habib Diarra (Sunderland) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
15' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sunderland.
15' Christopher Rigg (Sunderland) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.

13' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Robin Roefs makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner.
11' Nottingham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
10' Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
9' Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

8' Christopher Rigg (Sunderland) unleashes a beautiful mid-range volley low to the middle of the goal, but his effort is thwarted by the keeper, and the score remains the same.s a beautiful mid-range volley low to the middle of the goal, but his effort is thwarted by the keeper, and the score doesn't change.
8' Christopher Rigg (Sunderland) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.

3' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
3' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) collects a pass and has an effort from distance which is blocked.
